description: Defines a 'Review' entity class used for performance reviews, including fields for employee ID, reviewer name, rating, comments, and timestamp. It maps to a MongoDB collection and includes standard getters and setters.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Entity class representing a performance review with qualitative feedback and a rating, mapped to MongoDB collection 'reviews'.

methods.name: Review
methods.description: Parameterized constructor to initialize all fields.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the review.

methods.name: getEmployeeId
methods.description: Returns the employee's ID being reviewed.

methods.name: getReviewerName
methods.description: Returns the name of the reviewer.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the review.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the review.

methods.name: setTimestamp
methods.description: Sets the timestamp of the review.
